joosinkw 12/05/24 Replying to @joosinkw 3. 꿀팁 (Kkul-tip) This word combines "꿀" (honey) and "팁" (tip), referring to an extremely useful or valuable piece of advice. Example: 시험 준비할 때 꿀팁 좀 알려줘! = "Can you give me some really useful tips for preparing for the test?" 3 1

joosinkw 12/05/24 Why use "꿀" in these phrases? In Korean, "꿀" (honey) is often associated with sweetness, enjoyment, and value, making it perfect for slang that expresses positivity and fun. Try using them yourself! What’s your latest "꿀맛" experience? Have you received any "꿀팁" recently? Or maybe you’ve enjoyed a "꿀잼" show or event? Share your examples in the comments—I’d love to hear them! 2
